data.one_liner: A Flutter ListView that allows you to group list items and support headers.
data.what_it_does: Provides a GroupListView widget that helps organize list items into distinct sections with headers, similar to iOS UITableView sections. It supports custom item builders, group header builders, and optional separators.
use_when: You need to display a list of items categorized into groups or sections.
You want custom section headers for your list items similar to iOS UITableView.
avoid_when: You only need a simple, flat list without groupings or section headers.
You need complex sliver-based grouping (use standard Flutter slivers instead).
strengths: Supports group headers and list items grouping out of the box.
Exposes all fields from the standard ListView.builder constructor.
Supports both item and section separators.
weaknesses: Limited to basic grouped list scenarios.
No specific mention of advanced performance optimization for massive virtualized trees beyond standard ListView builder capabilities.
